jobs.title: Director of FP&A
jobs.summary: Lead financial planning, forecasting, and decision support at Paravane Labs as the operational intelligence product portfolio grows.
description: Paravane is looking for a Director of FP&A to establish and lead financial planning, forecasting, and management reporting across the company.

This role partners closely with company leadership and product operations to turn financial and operating data into clear decisions. You will build the planning discipline needed for a focused software company while keeping the work practical, visible, and useful.
responsibilities: Own annual planning, rolling forecasts, and long-range financial models across revenue, operating expenses, cash, and headcount.
Build management reporting that connects financial performance with product usage, customer activity, and operating priorities.
Partner with leadership on pricing, packaging, investment decisions, and scenario planning.
Develop clear metrics and review rhythms that help teams understand performance and act early.
Improve finance systems, controls, and data quality without adding unnecessary process.
Prepare concise materials for leadership, ownership, and other stakeholders.
qualifications: Substantial FP&A, strategic finance, or corporate finance experience in software, SaaS, or another technology business.
Experience building forecasts and operating models in an evolving environment.
Strong command of financial statements, unit economics, cash planning, and management reporting.
Ability to explain complex financial information clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
A hands-on approach, sound judgment, and comfort moving between strategy and detailed execution.
High standards for accuracy, discretion, and accountable decision-making.
aboutParavane: Paravane builds software for identifying risk, unusual activity, and signals that are easy to miss in everyday business systems.

Paravane Labs is a wholly owned subsidiary of DOYDL Technologies. Our first public product, smtpRS, brings email risk intelligence developed through years of private production use to a broader market.
